dct_description_sm: Chile administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 16 - Admin 2: 56 - Admin 3: 345 Dates associated with this dataset: - 17 February 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 08 October 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 05 September 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 05 September 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: La Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile (BCN)
